title: Fines for Restaurant Management When Patrons Flout No-smoking Laws
what_it_is: Fines for Restaurant Management When Patrons Flout No-smoking Laws

sections.label: Smoking ban in public areas
sections.summary: The Ministry's long-term goal is to prohibit smoking in all public areas except at designated smoking areas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: My Ministry's long-term goal is to prohibit smoking in all public areas except at designated smoking areas.

sections.label: Fines for smoking in prohibited areas
sections.summary: Smokers in prohibited areas like shopping malls and food shops face a maximum $1,000 fine, with about 19,000 tickets issued in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Persons caught smoking in areas where smoking is prohibited, such as in shopping malls and food shops, are liable for a maximum fine of $1,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In 2016, about 19,000 tickets were issued to smokers for smoking in prohibited areas, including more than 2,600 tickets issued to those found smoking in food establishments.

sections.label: Duty of smoke-free premises operators
sections.summary: Operators and managers of smoke-free premises must stop patrons smoking or ask them to leave, with about 400 enforcement actions in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The operators and managers of smoke-free premises, therefore, have a legal duty to stop patrons from smoking or to request patrons to leave the premises if they refuse to stop smoking.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In 2016, NEA took about 400 enforcement actions against the operators and managers of premises who had not fulfilled their duty under the law.
